description: This PHP source file defines the AddRolePermissionCommand class, which is a console command used to add user role permissions to a data group within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes command configuration, interaction prompts, execution logic for persisting permissions, and utility methods for displaying data and SQL snippets.

classes.name: AddRolePermissionCommand
classes.description: A Symfony Console Command class that facilitates adding permissions for user roles to a data group in OrangeHRM. Provides argument and option handling, interaction prompts, permission creation, and SQL snippet generation for logging or scripting purposes.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Defines the command's description, arguments, and options.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the command with SymfonyStyle for input/output interaction.

methods.name: interact
methods.description: Interactive prompting to gather required arguments and options from the user.

methods.name: getDataGroupAutocompleteQuestion
methods.description: Creates an autocomplete question for selecting data group names.

methods.name: getUserRoleAutocompleteQuestion
methods.description: Creates an autocomplete question for selecting user roles.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution logic to create and persist a DataGroupPermission entity based on user input or parameters.

methods.name: printDataGroupPermissionTable
methods.description: Displays a table of existing permissions for the specified data group.

methods.name: printDataGroupPermissionSQL
methods.description: Generates sample SQL insert statements for the permission, useful for logging or scripting.

methods.name: printBlock
methods.description: Outputs a formatted block message in the console, typically used for SQL snippets.
